clue.text: Factor that makes a business competent

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business
competent means efficient, able to do a job well

explanation.surface: Something that turns a firm into a capable outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a numerical multiplier of a variable is called a factor of that term.

clue.text: At one time it was reduced twice

definitions.text: At one time it was reduced twice

parts.words: At one time it was reduced twice
parts.note: reads as history of a cut; really 'twice' cut in half leaves a single time, which also means formerly

explanation.surface: Something was cut back twice in the past.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means formerly, at one time, and is also what remains when two times are halved.

clue.text: Money brings pleasure to many

parts.note: pleasure means fun, enjoyment
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number, so many

explanation.surface: Cash makes plenty of people happy.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum of cash set aside for a purpose is a stock of capital.

clue.text: Put into liquidation?

parts.note: reads as winding up a company; really means plunging something into liquid

explanation.surface: A firm is wound up by its creditors.
explanation.definitionFit: To dunk something is to submerge it in a fluid, punningly a liquid-ation.

clue.text: Desire to give the Cockney a lift

indicators.note: Cockneys famously drop their aitches, so the H at the start is lost

parts.note: a hitch is a free lift, as when hitchhiking

explanation.surface: Wanting to offer a Londoner a ride in your car.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class Londoner, whose accent drops the H at the start of words.
explanation.definitionFit: A craving or yearning is an urge, figuratively an itch.

clue.text: I've entered into neat arrangement that's simplicity itself

indicators.note: these letters go inside the scrambled letters of the following word
an arrangement of the word neat means its letters are reordered

parts.note: taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A tidy setup that is wonderfully easy.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as an exclamation, 'that's simplicity itself', but only 'simplicity' defines; 'arrangement' scrambles neat.
explanation.definitionFit: Artlessness or innocence, a lack of worldly sophistication, is a synonym.

clue.text: Gaining a job at the end of the course?

parts.note: gaining a race or a prize means winning it
a post is a job or position

explanation.surface: Landing employment just as one finishes one's studies.
explanation.definitionFit: In horse racing the marker at the finish line of the track is this structure.

clue.text: Knock on wood if you want to become such a player

definitions.text: Knock on wood if you want to become such a player

parts.words: Knock on wood if you want to become such a player
parts.note: reads as a superstitious charm for luck; really someone who strikes wooden bars to make music

explanation.surface: Touch wood for luck if you hope to make the team.
explanation.definitionFit: A musician who strikes the tuned wooden bars of a percussion instrument with beaters.

clue.text: It's purely symbolic

parts.note: reads as a dismissive remark; really a flower that symbolises purity

explanation.surface: A gesture that means nothing in practice.
explanation.definitionFit: The white flower is a traditional emblem of purity and innocence.

clue.text: Not lavish state assistance?

parts.note: reads as stingy government help; really financial help in the economy sense, with economical meaning thrifty

explanation.surface: Government handouts that are rather meagre.
explanation.definitionFit: Financial support given by one country to another, with the first word also hinting at thrift.

clue.text: Union leaders firm that's great for the Scots

parts.note: the leading letters of the word Union
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: Trade union bosses praise a company in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scots dialect word meaning remarkable or extraordinary, used as an intensifier.

clue.text: HMS London?

parts.note: a warship named after a capital city; really a major warship class

explanation.surface: A Royal Navy vessel named for the city.
explanation.definitionFit: A battleship or major warship of the largest class, and London is a capital city.

clue.text: Locksmith

parts.note: reads as someone who makes locks for doors; really someone who works on locks of hair

explanation.surface: A tradesman who fits door locks.
explanation.definitionFit: A stylist cuts and styles tresses, or locks of hair, so is a craftsman of locks.

clue.text: Opposed to profit in a way

indicators.note: the profit word sits inside the letters for a way

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
profit means gain

explanation.surface: Someone disapproves of making money somehow.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hostile or contrary to something is the preposition meaning versus.

clue.text: Clipped trees into shape

indicators.note: putting the letters of trees into a new shape signals reordering them

explanation.surface: A gardener prunes bushes into a topiary design.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipped speech is brief and curt.

clue.text: Stop being loyal

definitions.meaning: to stop the flow of blood from a wound

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb meaning stem a flow and an adjective meaning steadfast.

clue.text: Located or spotted by ear

indicators.note: judging by ear means the word is heard, not read

parts.note: spotted means seen, sighted

explanation.surface: Someone found by listening for them.
explanation.definitionFit: A building placed in a particular position is situated there.

clue.text: Eastern lake found in the West? Strange

parts.note: Lake Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America, in the Western world

explanation.surface: An Oriental lake turns up in the Occident, oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: Weird and uncanny, causing unease.

clue.text: Anger about one point of Latin in the matter

indicators.note: the anger word goes around the point letter

parts.note: ire means anger
N, north, is one point of the compass

explanation.surface: Irritation over a single detail of the Latin language.
explanation.walkthrough: IRE goes around N, giving I-N-RE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means concerning or with regard to, used in legal headings and memos.

clue.text: It gives the batsman a break

definitions.text: It gives the batsman a break

parts.words: It gives the batsman a break
parts.note: reads as a rest for the batsman; really the turn of a ball off the pitch in cricket

explanation.surface: A pause in play lets the cricketer rest.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a ball that 'breaks' deviates sideways off the pitch; bowlers impart turn to achieve it.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotation imparted to a cricket ball makes it deviate, or break, after bouncing.

clue.text: One advantage of bringing back a savings scheme

indicators.note: bringing back the scheme's name means writing it in reverse

parts.note: TESSA was a Tax Exempt Special Savings Account, a British savings scheme of the 1990s

explanation.surface: The benefit of reviving an old savings plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bringing back' turns TESSA, a 1990s British tax-free savings account, into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A useful quality or benefit is a plus or resource.

clue.text: A record about which there's some correspondence?

indicators.note: the word for some goes around the other pieces

parts.note: some means any
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: A document prompting some exchange of letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'correspondence' here means a likeness, not letters exchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: A likeness or parallel between two things is a correspondence between them.

clue.text: Recording start of the sport of kings

indicators.note: the start of the word the means its opening letter

parts.note: horse racing is traditionally called the sport of kings

explanation.surface: Filming the beginning of a horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: Copying lines or drawing a record of a path is plotting or following it.

clue.text: A service for car and plane travellers

definitions.text: A service for car and plane travellers

parts.words: A service for car and plane travellers
parts.note: a garage hose that pumps tyres for motorists, and a company flying passengers

explanation.surface: A facility used both by drivers and flyers.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrier offering scheduled flights, and also a hose supplying compressed gas to tyres.

clue.text: Gets ready to eat, or to be eaten

definitions.meaning: puts on formal clothes for dinner
prepares food for the table, as with a salad or a carcass

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both putting on evening clothes and preparing food such as poultry or salad.

clue.text: It's worn to order, perhaps

parts.note: reads as made-to-measure clothing; really a band worn by members of an order of chivalry

explanation.surface: A garment made to the customer's specification.
explanation.definitionFit: A band of cloth worn across the body, often as insignia of an order of knighthood.

clue.text: Self-righteous declaration made by Zulu warriors

definitions.meaning: a smug claim of being pious, 'I am pi', pi being slang for sanctimonious

explanation.definitionFit: A Zulu regiment, and split up it is a boast of being sanctimonious.

clue.text: A rise for flying men, now well off

indicators.note: in a down entry a rise means reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is made up of airmen

explanation.surface: Airmen given a pay increase are now comfortably wealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: At a great distance, far away.

clue.text: I play in Roman children's game

definitions.meaning: the Latin verb for I play
a simple board game with dice and counters

explanation.definitionFit: The board game takes its name from the Latin first-person verb meaning I play.

clue.text: From the French, as it should be

definitions.text: From the French, as it should be

parts.words: From the French, as it should be
parts.note: a borrowed French phrase meaning proper or correct

explanation.surface: Something taken from France, as is fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase meaning proper, in accordance with etiquette.

clue.text: Time to change article

indicators.note: the letters of time are to change their order

explanation.surface: It is the moment to swap one object for another.
explanation.definitionFit: An individual thing in a list or collection is an object or piece.

clue.text: Mistake made by a key worker

definitions.text: Mistake made by a key worker

parts.words: Mistake made by a key worker
parts.note: reads as an essential worker's blunder; really a slip by someone pressing keyboard keys

explanation.surface: An essential employee makes a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip on the keyboard by a typist, a worker of keys.
